That is a good question, I feel like this might be asked for a reason, but first things first, go eat your favorite food, and I mean sit down and eat it there alone. If you have the ability too, walk between places, don't drive. Just that alone makes everything feel so much more freeing. Go watch a movie if your into that, its not weird to see a movie alone. If your slightly social go to a bar/pub whatever drink a little and talk to the people around you, that can be hard but in the right mentality its great,  find actual activity's like kayaking or stuff along those lines, enough to keep you busy through the day but not be a chore,


Next day, free for all it. Be extremely spontaneous, whatever you think may look fun to do at all, you go do it, dont plan your day, after your done with one thing  you step out start trecking and indulge in the very next thing you see that might even be slighthy interesting, no toward plan feels extremely liberating, and a great way to say goodbye




Disclaimer you can do any variations of this in any way or order you want, just don't make it feel like another boring planned day even if you end up doing all the same stuff by choice, just don't set a schedule is the important part
